Account.summaryTitle: Please fix the following to continue
Account.prefillNote: You are signed in as {email}. Your details are filled in below.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: Rwandan numbers can be written 078 123 4567. From abroad, start with + and your country code.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words work well.

register.title: Create an <accent>account</accent>
register.intro: An account is optional. It fills in your details when you request a ride and lets you see your past requests.
register.sentText: If this address can be used, we have sent a link to confirm it. The link works for 24 hours. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.

login.title: <accent>Sign in</accent>
login.intro: Sign in to see your requests and to fill in your details automatically.
login.guestHint: You do not need an account to request a ride.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. You can sign in now.
login.deleted: Your account and requests were deleted.
login.resendSent: If this address is waiting for confirmation, we sent a new link.

forgot.title: Forgot your <accent>password</accent>?
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: If an account exists for this address, we have sent a link to choose a new password. It works for 1 hour. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.

reset.title: Choose a new <accent>password</accent>
reset.intro: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.invalidText: The link was already used or has expired. You can ask for a new one.

verify.okText: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue. Requests you made earlier with this email address now appear in your account.
verify.invalidText: The link was already used or has expired. If you already confirmed your email, you can sign in. Otherwise, try to sign in and we will offer to send a new link.

requests.title: My <accent>requests</accent>
requests.intro: Your latest ride requests and where they stand.
requests.note: Questions about a request? Call or WhatsApp ELVAIS and mention the reference code.

settings.title: Account <accent>settings</accent>
settings.deleteText: This permanently deletes your account and every request linked to it. It cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Yes, delete my account and my requests

errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.invalid: The email or password is not correct.
errors.blocked: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.unverified: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Use the link we sent you, or ask for a new one below.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests from your connection. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.invalidLink: This link no longer works. Ask for a new one.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
